Partitioning ordered x+y=b pairs by relative valuations gives A_t: unlike valuations require their minimum t, equal smaller valuations contribute a whole shell, equal t yield (q-2)q^(m-t-1). The diagonal 2x=b gives D_t separately in odd p, p=2,m=1, p=2,m>=2. Thus N2=(A_t-D_t)/2, and the units-shell positivity plus the first nilpotent shell V_d yields the claimed exact odd/binary coverage criterion, including b=0 and m=d.
